description: Dept. of Local Government Eastern Province - Notice of Summon of meeting under Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act 22/2012
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the summoning of meetings to fill vacancies for Chairman positions in local authorities (Pradeshiya Sabhas) resulting from resignations. This falls under electoral processes for local government bodies, specifically addressing vacancies and election procedures under the Local Authorities Elections Act, making it clearly an Elections Gazette.
